messages.author: 3700377e1a73887a
messages.subject: % variation explained
parts:
Hi, karl

If I only detect one major QTL for the scan, what is the correct way to calculate the % variation explained by this QTL. As I understand, the fitqtl is for multiple QTL, is that also can be used for single QTL just as a formula=y`Q1?

or there is some other way to calculate it?

Thank you and best,

Jie

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] % variation explained
parts:
Yes, to calculate % variance explained by a QTL, use fitqtl, just with y~Q1. It will work for a single-QTL model.

karl
